$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-kinetic pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder's ACM path (skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/seed.mjs renderAcm looks each instance up as `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names VERBATIM, as references/templates-and-patterns.md:83-85 requires for a from-joomla adapter and as tracy-base writes them; the uniform eyebrow/heading/intro vocabulary in wp-tracy-business belongs to the from-html adapter and is not used here. metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>], <n> being the 1-based row of a repeat group; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n> and carries no role, so cloning or deleting it changes the row count (accordion is the one exception: its wrapper is accordion.row.<n>, because accordion.item.<n> is already the details block a `summary`-attr field targets, and a row also carries an optional group header that must clone with it — see the accordion entry's `q` field note). A block is located by name, never by position. `attr` says where the value lands: content, text (a button label), href, src+alt, className (a value that is not text but selects a class), summary, table, links. A field the spec leaves empty removes its block; `dropped` names fields a pattern deliberately does not carry, and why. Two styles of one type (clients, bento) share the field vocabulary and differ only in which fields exist and which pattern renders them: each style is its own `<type>:<style>` entry. The stylesheet is assets/css/wp-ja-kinetic-sections.css, the source's own per-section sheets ported behind a bridge that declares the template's custom properties from this theme's presets; inc/extra.php enqueues it as wp-ja-kinetic-sections. The numeric keys at the end are the pages' section ids (page-map `sections[].modules`): the contract and Fast Gate read a page's pattern through them (contract.mjs patternSlugsOf), so each names the pattern its module renders (for features-ledger the layout the instance carries), its root, and only the fields whose row-1 block carries a className, i.e. the ones that can be paired with the source. The seeder reads the `<type>:<style>` entries above, never the numeric ones.
anchorConvention: core/group (every pattern's root block, and the root of every style variant) already supports the standard `anchor` attribute with no change needed here — setting `"anchor":"acm-<type>-<source id>"` in the root wp:group's attrs (source id = the Joomla ACM module id the instance came from, e.g. `acm-features-intro-193`) makes it render `id="acm-<type>-<source id>"` on the section, byte-identical to the source's own `id="acm-<type>-<mid>"` (acm/<type>/tmpl/style-1.php, `echo $module->id`). The seeder must set this anchor on every instance it creates: several source pages carry per-instance overrides in css/page-<Itemid>.css scoped to that literal id (grep the stylesheet for `#acm-` to find them) that never match anything without it — verified on a probe (2026-09-22): setting the anchor on a features-intro instance made the already-ported `body.item-218 #acm-features-intro-193 .hx-section` rule apply and match the source's measured background exactly. One id in the ported CSS is dead regardless: `#acm-features-intro-194` in css/page-218.css was authored when module 194 was still a features-intro instance; it is now features-ledger (layout metrics) and no instance will ever carry that id again.

views.$comment: A view whose body the source draws with a component, not with ACM sections: the theme draws it with one of its blocks, placed after the named position. page-contact is com_contact (form#contact-form: name, email, subject, message, consent), drawn by blocks/kinetic-contact-form between the page-top masthead and the page-bottom call to action. Naming it here also tells the seeder the theme owns the contact form, so no Contact Form 7 is installed. A view the source answers with something other than 200 declares that answer under `expect`, which the seeder probes: page-account is com_users profile, which sends a visitor who is not logged in to the login page (source /index.php/pages/profile -> 303 -> /index.php/pages/login; the theme does the same). A view the theme serves at its own path declares `servedAtPath`, and the seeder adds no redirect for it: search is com_finder at /pages/search on the source, and the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/list-pages.php, D-35).

image_terminal.note: the source names a per-direction panel image and falls back to images/kinetic/hero-terminal-panel-<direction>.webp when the field is empty; every measured instance is empty. attr stays src+alt on purpose: no spec instance carries a value for image_terminal, image_blueprint or image_signal, and the seeder removes a core/image whose src field is empty (seed.mjs `case 'src'`), so a `src` declaration would delete the panel. No CSS change needed once the real files are in — the shift is not a theme bug. attr stays src+alt on purpose: no spec instance carries a value for image_terminal, image_blueprint or image_signal, and the seeder removes a core/image whose src field is empty (seed.mjs `case 'src'`), so a `src` declaration would delete the panel. As src+alt the seeder leaves the block alone and the pattern's own image stays: the pattern points each direction at the source's fallback file (`acm/kineticql-split/tmpl/style-1.php:24-26`), copied to assets/images/kineticql-code-panel-<terminal|blueprint|signal>.webp (step 6b).

The repeat wrapper (patterns.map.json `item`, above) is accordion.row.<n> — one row's optional group header plus its details — not the details block itself: a group header sits between rows in the source's flat list, and repeatItems clones one contiguous span of matched items, so a wrapper that is only the details drops every group header that is not the first block in the list. Previously attr 'content' -> setText wrote the whole newline-joined string as one text run inside <ul> (no <li> at all, measured live pricing 187, before this fix) and needed a pricing-only post-repeat rebuild; that rebuild is removed, this is now the same generic pass every other repeat field goes through.

The card wrapper carries a custom `url` attribute (default `#`, matching the source's own default); `wp_ja_kinetic_clients_card_link()` in inc/extra.php reads it at render time and swaps the wrapper's rendered `<div>` for an `<a href>`, adding target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" for an absolute http(s) value — core/group has no anchor-tag or href support of its own

tile-icon.note: not text: the icon key selects the wrapper class is-ico-<key> on the tile's icon leaf (an empty core/paragraph carrying a CSS mask — in both styles swapped at render time for the source's `span > svg`, inc/extra.php wp_ja_kinetic_bento_style2_svg; a filler's appended `hx-ico-<key>` wins as the last key class —, metadata.name bento.tile-icon.<n> — same cloning risk as tile-span, same fix: reapply per instance after repeatItems). Prefix: `is-ico-${value}`, remove any existing `is-ico-*` class first

icon.note: icon key → hx-ico-<key>; on render inc/extra.php (wp_ja_kinetic_ledger_icon_svg) turns it into the source's span.hx-spec-icon / span.hx-stat-icon > svg (CSS mask in the editor only)

role.note: one block draws two fields: the source joins role and company with ", " inside one element (acm/testimonials/tmpl/style-1.php:51-54, role alone when company is empty). role and company both mapping to this same path independently overwrote each other ("Northwind" instead of "Staff SRE, Northwind"). seed.mjs writes role alone; the run's post-seed step (tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/post-seed.mjs, D-34) rewrites this block to role and company joined, and each avatar's alt to its own person's name

chip.note: the terminal-style code chip; the source draws it only on the 3 of 14 measured cta instances that carry a `chip` value (184, 234, 235) — the other 11 have no `chip` key in sections.json at all, not even empty. Measured 2026-09-22 run 3 (SB-21/SA-47): the generic field pass only calls put() `if (name in inst.fields)`, so an absent key (as opposed to an explicit empty string) left the pattern's own default "helix init" chip on every one of those 11 pages. Fixed 2026-09-22 (fix-patterns-b2) in parity-tools/fill.mjs with a cta-only branch that treats the absent key the same as an empty value (removes the block) — a future real seeder needs the same absent-key-is-empty handling for this field.

variant.note: not text: it selects the wrapper class cta-<variant>. The pattern ships cta-card, the value 12 of 13 measured instances carry; id 211 carries `bar`, which neither tmpl/style-1.xml nor css/style.css knows. Targets the pattern's OWN root wp:group (path equals the bare type name, same convention as page-masthead.align below) — that block must carry `metadata.name:"cta"` for the filler's findBlock to locate it at all; measured live (2026-09-22, run 3) with the metadata missing: every one of the 14 captured cta instances logged "no block for cta", and instance 211 (variant bar) rendered with the cta-card class still on it. Fixed by adding the metadata name to section-cta.php's root block.
